articles.title: World Bank bumps up FY27 India growth outlook to 7.1%
articles.summary: The World Bank has increased the growth forecast for India's FY27 to 7.1% from earlier estimates. Authorities suspect that these shipments are actually originating from Nigeria to avoid applicable tariffs. As a result, importers must now validate the authenticity of their cargoes or incur significant duties. This scrutiny has effectively paused purchases labeled as from Niger, leading to potential delays for goods en route and altering trade dynamics.
